text:
1. Isaac is the child of the covenant.
2. The nations are to be blessed through Isaac.
3. The chapter turns the covenant promise into a test.
4. Set beside the earlier promise, the difference between promise and test narrows.
5. The scene hinges on the Hebrew word "hineni," meaning "here I am."
6. Abraham says "hineni" three times.
7. Abraham says "hineni" once to God, once to Isaac, and once to the angel.
8. Each time Abraham says "hineni," the word means something different.
9. Each successive "hineni" costs Abraham more.
10. Declaring presence is bound up with loss.
